summary: BP p.l.c., a petroleum refining company, filed a Form 6-K on May 26, 2026, reporting the immediate removal of Chair Albert Manifold by the Board due to governance, oversight, and conduct concerns. Amanda Blanc, Senior Independent Director, noted unacceptable issues. Ian Tyler was appointed Interim Chair, and a succession process for a permanent Chair will begin. The Board reaffirmed its strategic direction and support for CEO Meg O'Neill. No financial terms, premiums, or deal mechanics are involved. This is a forced, abrupt board leadership change, not a routine meeting or compensation filing. Watch for further governance or strategic shifts.
